Definition: an Abiezrite or descendant of Abiezer
BiblicalUsage: The Abi-ezrite is a descendant of Abiezer — the clan name used of Gideon and his family. The angel finds Gideon 'in Ophrah... which pertained unto Joash the Abi-ezrite'; Gideon builds an altar there; and he is buried 'in Ophrah of the Abi-ezrites'.
TheologicalSignificance: Gideon is introduced by his clan, and his clan is the smallest in Manasseh — and God calls the least man of the least family to save Israel. I believe the Abi-ezrite label is the point: God does not need a great family to do a great work, and He never has.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
